title: Vertices that belong to every minimum dominating set of a graph and their connection with transportation sharing systems with study cases in Campo de Gibraltar area
summary: This study addresses a theoretical model regarding equity and accessibility challenges in designing shared transportation systems (such as micro-mobility networks) by applying graph-vertex domination setting. The work focuses on identifying dominating forced vertices, that represent nodes belonging to every dominating set of a graph of the smallest possible cardinality, and which correspond to critical, non-negotiable station locations essential for maintaining system efficiency and coverage.
